newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end lower, but off session lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end lower, but off session lows.

text.p: June 30 - U.S. debt futures ended lower but off the morning lows after selling dried up around midsession, traders said. Futures then began a low-volume bounce as the market focus turned to Tuesday and the start of the Fed's two-day policy meeting. Traders said expectations for FOMC to leave short-term rates unchanged this month underpinned prices.
